name: Trane Technologies plc
tagline: Global climate innovator delivering sustainable and efficient solutions for buildings, homes and transportation
hero_kpi_rationale: Principal segment de Trane (environ 80 % du CA), il porte la croissance structurelle du CVC commercial et des centres de données en Amérique du Nord.

kpis.signal: Commandes record a 6,7 Md$ au T1-2026, +24% organique porte par le HVAC commercial Americas.
Commandes organiques +24% au T1-2026, acceleration nette apres un creux fin 2022-2023.
Carnet record de 10,7 Md$ au T1-2026, +30% vs fin 2025, forte visibilite sur 2026.
Book-to-bill de 135% au T1-2026, tres au-dessus de 100%, signe d'une demande superieure aux livraisons.
CA organique +3% au T1-2026, croissance ralentie par le residentiel et la refrigeration transport.
Commandes HVAC commercial Americas ~+40% au T1-2026, moteur strategique de croissance du groupe.
Commandes de solutions appliquees Americas +160% au T1-2026, troisieme trimestre consecutif de croissance superieure a 100%, portee par les data centers.

kpis.name_fr: Carnet apporte par l'acquisition Stellar Energy
kpis.signal: L'acquisition de Stellar Energy (refroidissement modulaire data centers) apporte 1 Md$ de carnet, avec 500 M$ de CA attendus en 2026 et une cible de 1 Md$ de CA a 2-3 ans.

kpis.short: Combined Americas and EMEA backlog increase since year-end 2025
kpis.name_fr: Hausse carnet combine Americas et EMEA vs fin 2025
kpis.signal: Carnet combine HVAC commercial Americas et EMEA en hausse d'environ 2,7 Md$ depuis fin 2025, dont ~1,8 Md$ de croissance organique.
Plus de 21 usines aux Etats-Unis (20 US + 1 Mexique dans les Americas), avec plus de 95% des produits vendus aux US fabriques ou assembles localement, avantage face aux tarifs.

kpis.name_fr: Techniciens de service dans le monde
kpis.signal: Plus de 7 500 techniciens de service dans le monde, cle pour capter la longue queue de revenus de service sur la base installee croissante.
Plus de 15 Md$ deployes via l'allocation de capital equilibree depuis 2020, soutenus par une conversion de free cash flow de 106%.
Croissance annuelle moyenne du BPA ajuste de 24% depuis 2020, avec un CA en hausse de 11% par an et une marge EBITDA ajustee elargie de 470 points de base.

Acquisition strategique le 2 janvier 2025 de BrainBox AI, plateforme d'optimisation HVAC par intelligence artificielle, financee sur tresorerie; goodwill combine 190 M USD, integree au segment Americas.

ai_positioning.summary: Integre l'IA dans ses produits et operations existants pour ameliorer performance et experience client.

risks.title: Litigation Risk - Asbestos Claims
risks.score_rationale: Aldrich and Murray subsidiaries filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2020 to address asbestos-related claims. A $270M qualified settlement fund was established in March 2022. First phase of liability estimation hearing scheduled for August 2026. Outcome remains uncertain and could have material financial impact. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "For detailed information on the bankruptcy cases of Aldrich and Murray, see Part I, Item". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Company faces significant asbestos litigation through Chapter 11 proceedings of subsidiaries. Estimated liability and case duration remain uncertain.

risks.title: Competitive and Technology Risk
risks.score_rationale: Rapid technological change, including AI, increases risk of product lifecycle shortening. Competition from alternative solutions and new market entrants could lead to decreased demand and reduced market share. Company must continuously innovate to maintain competitive position. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "We monitor key competitors and customers in order to gauge relative performance and the outlook". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Company must innovate continuously to compete with emerging AI-driven solutions and alternative technologies in HVAC and building automation markets.

risks.title: Geopolitical and Trade Policy Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company operates globally and is exposed to tariff changes, trade policy uncertainty, and geopolitical disruptions. U.S. tariffs announced and implemented in 2025, with retaliatory measures from other countries, create supply chain and cost volatility risks. Company is monitoring dynamic global trade policy developments. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "These global trade policy changes continue to be dynamic and, as a result, we may". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Global trade policy changes including tariffs create supply chain challenges, commodity cost volatility, and economic uncertainty affecting operations and end markets.

risks.title: Market Demand and Macroeconomic Risk
risks.score_rationale: Residential markets weakened considerably in 2025 due to regulatory refrigerant transition and softer consumer demand. Transport refrigeration markets experience weaker demand. Asia shows mixed macro-economic conditions. Economic risks and higher interest rates create uncertainties. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Residential markets have weakened considerably throughout 2025 due to navigating a regulatory refrigerant transition and". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Residential and transport refrigeration markets face headwinds from regulatory transitions, consumer demand softness, and macroeconomic uncertainties.

risks.title: AI Implementation and Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: AI presents emerging issues and pace of change creates uncertainties. Company may experience competitive harm, reputational harm, or legal liability from AI implementation. Risk of product failures or customer dissatisfaction with AI-driven solutions. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "We believe our business operating system, our in-region for region strategy, and strength in execution". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: AI integration in products and operations presents emerging risks including competitive disadvantage, reputational harm, and potential legal liability from AI failures.

risks.title: Innovation and Talent Risk
risks.score_rationale: Successful innovation depends on attracting and retaining highly skilled talent in engineering, technology, and product management. Labor market constraints and increased competition for skilled professionals may delay innovation initiatives or increase costs. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "We believe our business operating system, our in-region for region strategy, and strength in execution". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Competition for skilled talent in engineering and AI domains could delay innovation and increase compensation costs, affecting competitiveness.

risks.title: Regulatory and Sustainability Compliance Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company must comply with environmental and social regulations across multiple jurisdictions. Regulatory refrigerant transitions and environmental compliance requirements affect product development and market availability. Non-compliance could result in fines and operational restrictions. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Residential markets have weakened considerably throughout 2025 due to navigating a regulatory refrigerant transition and". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Environmental and social regulations, including refrigerant transitions, require product adaptations and create market volatility.

company_description: Trane Technologies plc designs, manufactures, sells, and services of solutions for heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and custom and transport refrigeration. It offers air conditioners, exchangers, and handlers; airside and terminal devices; air sourced heat pumps; chillers; coils and condensers; auxiliary power, cold storage, and condensing units; controls contracting and commissioning, decarbonization programs, and gensets; dehumidifiers; energy and water efficiency programs; energy recovery ventilators and power solutions; energy storage; furnaces; home automation; humidifiers; HVAC performance-monitoring products; and indoor air quality assessments and related products for HVAC and transport solutions. The company also provides asset management, building management, bus air purification, bus and rail HVAC, container refrigeration, control, ductless, geothermal, data center and multi-pipe HVAC, package heating and cooling, rail refrigeration, residential air filtration, self and vehicle powered truck refrigeration, temporary heating and cooling, truck refrigeration, unitary, variable refrigerant flow, and trailer refrigeration systems.
